mechanism.claim: During elevated BTC variation, spot execution activity that predicts the next perpetual five-minute return more strongly than perpetual activity predicts the next spot return identifies cash-led price discovery. At a fresh upper-tail leadership onset, follow the common sign of the spot-to-perpetual response and completed perpetual displacement for eight elapsed hours.
mechanism.side: common strict sign of the spot-count-to-next-perpetual-return correlation and completed eight-hour perpetual return
mechanism.why_distinct: HVSFLR compares contemporaneous aggressive-flow imbalance strength, HVSPCLR compares return lead-lag, HVTLRR uses one-market quote turnover, HVECE normalizes endpoint displacement by total count, and spot trade-count sponsorship compares count levels. HVSEAL instead compares two directional cross-market predictive execution-count channels inside one completed block. It reuses no prior event set or control and uses no turnover, taker flow, ticket size, funding, OI, premium, fitted outcome, or post-entry data.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed perpetual eight-hour realized variation must occupy its causal upper 35 percent while cross-market predictive activity leadership must occupy its causal upper quartile
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: three fixed daily cross-market execution-activity leadership onsets are absent from Gross9 structural clocks

features.block: 96 exact aligned five-minute aggregates formed from 480 unique coherent BTCUSDT spot and perpetual one-minute rows in [D-8h,D)
features.five_minute_execution_count: sum integer nonnegative number_of_trades over each exact five-minute group, separately for spot and perpetual; every block total strict positive
features.activity_coordinate: log1p(five-minute execution count), separately for spot and perpetual
features.next_market_return: log(next five-minute close/next five-minute open) in the destination market
features.spot_to_perpetual_response: sample Pearson correlation of spot activity_coordinate[t] and perpetual next_market_return[t+1] across 95 ordered pairs; both sample standard deviations strict positive; correlation strict nonzero
features.perpetual_to_spot_response: sample Pearson correlation of perpetual activity_coordinate[t] and spot next_market_return[t+1] across the same 95 ordered pairs; both sample standard deviations strict positive
features.leadership_rank: strict-prior midrank of leadership_margin over at most 270 valid fixed blocks, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.75
features.perpetual_realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared perpetual five-minute log(close/open) returns), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 valid fixed blocks, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.completed_perpetual_return: log(last perpetual close/first perpetual open), finite strict nonzero and same sign as spot_to_perpetual_response
features.onset: eligible now and immediately previous exact source-valid block ineligible; missing previous block cannot trigger

clock.side: common sign of spot-to-perpetual response and completed perpetual return
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding_oi_premium: not signal inputs; exact funding only after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval and final

source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent bidirectional cross-market execution-activity price-discovery mechanism selected from schema and formula audit only

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no activity coordinate, lag, correlation, comparator, rank, onset, variation, confirmation, side, clock, hold, subset, threshold, or control repair
